title: Blair Pavilion, Ipswich

terrainReference.basis: Original terrain outward from the approximate main veranda. Threshold grade remains approximate.

mapIdentity.provider: UniSQ’s August 2022 campus directory names the photographed building as Blair Pavilion, Building X. Its schematic perimeter was registered approximately using the published map scale and OSM Buildings H and T as controls. The University of Queensland identifies the Blair Pavilion as the 1907–1908 building with distinctive roof ventilators.

positionReference.basis: Scale registration to UniSQ campus diagram

mapIdentity.scope: The official UniSQ campus plan identifies Building X as Blair Pavilion. It provides the approximate 56-metre roof outline, aligned using campus map scale and two named OpenStreetMap control buildings. The named controls establish site registration only.

note: The two cleared June 2016 Qualla photos establish the long white and brick pavilion, open veranda, red hip roofs, ventilators and east-end stair. The original terrain shows the ground sloping along the range. Height, setbacks, exact location and rear elevations are approximate.
